probes.name: no_protected_attributes
probes.description: The engine has no input for gender, caste, religion, community, disability or name.

probes.name: money_never_hides_best_fits
probes.description: Same student, family income Rs 2.4 lakh vs Rs 25 lakh: every career that fits the student well (fit at least 75 %) stays visible to the low-income family, in the ranked list or in stretch goals.

probes.name: best_for_student_ignores_money
probes.description: The 'best for the student' list is identical whatever the family earns.

probes.name: fit_ignores_home_region
probes.description: Where a student lives changes costs and local jobs, never how well a career fits them.

probes.name: category_scholarships_never_assumed
probes.description: Scholarships that depend on category, gender or disability are listed for students to check themselves and are never added to a funding plan automatically.
